title: Welcome To The Hearth
primary_purpose: Introduce the simulator as a world and learning path
music_language_role: Sets the frame for learning as language
own_condition: Learner can say why the simulator is a map and not a playlist

title: The 8 Nodes And How To Use Them
primary_purpose: Explain each node in plain language
music_language_role: Shows where vocabulary grammar conversation and poetry live
node_onboarding: Foundation Doing Knowing Practice Study Create Hearth Mastery
own_condition: Learner can choose the right node for a need
notes: Recommend Play as World or Traditions pathway rather than core node for now

title: How Lessons Work
music_language_role: Shows how fluency is built in steps
own_condition: Learner can identify the four lesson moves
notes: Keep this reusable for other domains

title: The Three Learning Barriers
music_language_role: Protects the language ladder from collapse
source_anchors: Hubbard study-tech note plus Hearth design notes
own_condition: Learner can name mass gradient or misunderstood word
notes: Use carefully and practically not dogmatically

title: What To Do When You Get Stuck
music_language_role: Builds repair habits like asking what word or step was missed
own_condition: Learner can choose simpler step word check or physical demo
notes: This should power Need More Work behaviour

title: Music As A Language
core_interaction: Hear speak language comparison ask step
own_condition: Learner can place notes chords rhythm song or improvisation on ladder

title: Vocabulary Grammar Conversation Poetry
own_condition: Learner can explain why beginners start with small phrases

title: The 12 Notes
primary_purpose: Introduce musical alphabet and repeating cycle
own_condition: Learner knows there are 12 notes before repetition

title: Pulse Rhythm And Counting
primary_purpose: Introduce time as the ground of music
own_condition: Learner can tap steady pulse and count four beats

title: Half Steps Whole Steps And Intervals
core_interaction: Small keyboard or fret gap cards
own_condition: Learner can explain half step as nearest next note

title: Strings Frets And Tab
own_condition: Learner can read open fret 1 and fret 2 in tab

title: Open Strings And Fret 12
own_condition: Learner can identify fret 12 as same letter name higher sound
notes: Do not introduce all notes too fast

title: Guitar Body And Posture
primary_purpose: Introduce instrument anatomy and body setup
music_language_role: The mouth and body of the language
own_condition: Learner can name headstock neck body and choose relaxed posture

title: Body Scan Warm-Up
own_condition: Learner completes tension scan and adjusts one place

title: First Sounds Rest Stroke And Free Stroke
primary_purpose: Connect right hand motion to tone
own_condition: Learner can hear or see difference between stroke types
notes: Buttons are Try Rest Stroke and Try Free Stroke

title: Left Hand Changes Pitch
music_language_role: Words change shape through the left hand
own_condition: Learner can fret one note without crushing tension

title: Moving Between Notes Open Fret 2 Open
primary_purpose: Make first phrase on one string
source_anchors: QJam JustinGuitar Guitar Exercises for Dummies
own_condition: Learner can follow open fret 2 open

title: First Chord E Major
own_condition: Learner attempts E major and listens for clear strings

title: How Practice Study And Create Continue This
primary_purpose: Show where to go next after Foundation
own_condition: Learner can choose next node based on goal
notes: This prevents ambiguity after first lesson

title: Own The Threshold
primary_purpose: Recap and commit to next path
source_anchors: Original Hearth orientation plus all source anchors
own_condition: Learner can explain what they learned and what they will do next
